As someone who has had traumatic dentistry in my past, it is of utmost importance to me that I feel comfortable and at ease in whatever practice I go to, and this place puts me at ease like no other. From the calm and relaxed manner of the people who take your booking over the phone, to the ambient / relaxing music played in the reception while waiting for your appointment. My dentist in particular (Jeffery) is very impressive in his dentistry skills and is also a perfectionist. If something isn't quite right he will work at it until it is. His manner is very calm, relaxed and respectful. Unlike some dentists I have visited in the past, I actually look forward to my appointments with him as I really appreciate how much care he takes during our time together (and in any work that needs doing). I needed quite a lot of extensive work done when I first started going here and he did it all with aplomb. It's satisfying watching someone work at this level.

I've been going here for 2 or 3 (I can't quite remember) years now and will continue going for as long as I can. Thanks so much Boutique Dental, you have done wonders for my general attitude towards dentistry.

My visit to Garden City Dentals came after a deeply distressing and disappointing journey elsewhere, and I feel compelled to share this experience because it restored my trust in dental care.
I developed a dental issue three months after my triple-bypass heart surgery, a time when any medical decision requires extreme care and sensitivity. I first visited another dentist, carefully handed over my complete medical file, underwent routine checks and three X-rays, and was advised to see a dental specialist. I was prescribed painkillers and billed accordingly. Though unsatisfied, I followed their recommendation.
The very next day, I visited the referred specialist clinic. Even before meeting the specialist, I was directed to undergo multiple X-rays and a 180-degree scan, resulting in a heavy bill. When I was finally called in, the specialist barely looked at me, did not review my medical records, and abruptly declared that nothing could be done because it was only three months after my heart surgery. I was sent out without discussion or explanation. I walked away feeling robbed, unheard, and deeply discouraged.
Seeking another opinion, I approached a different dentist. To my shock, they contacted the previous dentist without my consent to ask why I had not returned. At that point, I felt my privacy had been breached, and my confidence in the system was completely shaken.
That is when I walked into Garden City Dentals during afterhoursâ€”and everything changed.
From the very first interaction, the reception staff were cheerful, calm, and transparent, patiently explaining the process and putting me at ease. I was then seen by Dr Swati Kadian, whose approach was a complete contrast to what I had experienced before. She carefully examined me, reviewed my medical history, and only then suggested X-raysâ€”clearly explaining why they were needed, the costs involved, the number of visits required, and the treatment options available, including the immediate denture method.
What stood out most was her professional diagnosis and prognosisâ€”confident, thorough, and deeply reassuring. Given my recent heart surgery, I insisted on seeing a specialist, but Dr Kadian honestly and calmly declined, explaining that it was not necessary and that she was fully confident in managing my case safely. That clarity itself was comforting.
On the day of the extraction (three tooth from the upper jaw), her skill truly spoke for itself. The procedure was remarkably smooth and gentle. Her hands felt almost magical. At the slightest indication of discomfort, she immediately responded with additional anaesthesia, ensuring I felt no pain. Her approach was delicate, attentive, and compassionate throughout.
After months of anxiety, confusion, and disappointment, Garden City Dentalsâ€”and especially Dr Swati Kadianâ€”gave me something invaluable: confidence, dignity, and relief. This was not just dental treatment; it was care delivered with integrity and humanity.
I am profoundly grateful and would wholeheartedly recommend Garden City Dentals to anyone, especially those with complex medical histories who need not just treatment but understanding and trust. Splendid work, keep it up, team!

reviews.author: Pilli India
reviews.snippet:
My visit to Garden City Dentals came after a deeply distressing and disappointing journey elsewhere, and I feel compelled to share this experience because it restored my trust in dental care.
I developed a dental issue three months after my triple-bypass heart surgery, a time when any medical decision requires extreme care and sensitivity. I first visited another dentist, carefully handed over my complete medical file, underwent routine checks and three X-rays, and was advised to see a dental specialist. I was prescribed painkillers and billed accordingly. Though unsatisfied, I followed their recommendation.
The very next day, I visited the referred specialist clinic. Even before meeting the specialist, I was directed to undergo multiple X-rays and a 180-degree scan, resulting in a heavy bill. When I was finally called in, the specialist barely looked at me, did not review my medical records, and abruptly declared that nothing could be done because it was only three months after my heart surgery. I was sent out without discussion or explanation. I walked away feeling robbed, unheard, and deeply discouraged.
Seeking another opinion, I approached a different dentist. To my shock, they contacted the previous dentist without my consent to ask why I had not returned. At that point, I felt my privacy had been breached, and my confidence in the system was completely shaken.
That is when I walked into Garden City Dentals during afterhoursâ€”and everything changed.
From the very first interaction, the reception staff were cheerful, calm, and transparent, patiently explaining the process and putting me at ease. I was then seen by Dr Swati Kadian, whose approach was a complete contrast to what I had experienced before. She carefully examined me, reviewed my medical history, and only then suggested X-raysâ€”clearly explaining why they were needed, the costs involved, the number of visits required, and the treatment options available, including the immediate denture method.
What stood out most was her professional diagnosis and prognosisâ€”confident, thorough, and deeply reassuring. Given my recent heart surgery, I insisted on seeing a specialist, but Dr Kadian honestly and calmly declined, explaining that it was not necessary and that she was fully confident in managing my case safely. That clarity itself was comforting.
On the day of the extraction (three tooth from the upper jaw), her skill truly spoke for itself. The procedure was remarkably smooth and gentle. Her hands felt almost magical. At the slightest indication of discomfort, she immediately responded with additional anaesthesia, ensuring I felt no pain. Her approach was delicate, attentive, and compassionate throughout.
After months of anxiety, confusion, and disappointment, Garden City Dentalsâ€”and especially Dr Swati Kadianâ€”gave me something invaluable: confidence, dignity, and relief. This was not just dental treatment; it was care delivered with integrity and humanity.
I am profoundly grateful and would wholeheartedly recommend Garden City Dentals to anyone, especially those with complex medical histories who need not just treatment but understanding and trust. Splendid work, keep it up, team!

When she raised concerns about the visible gap after the repair, the receptionist dismissed her as being â€œpickyâ€ and attributed the issue to the age of the denture ~ despite it being only five years old. At no point during the repair process was she consulted about any changes to the plan or informed that the outcome would differ from the original promise of a simple, gap-free fix.
